english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the act of hunting and, by context, a hunting outing or expedition.
This is the all-purpose Cantonese expression for the activity of hunting wild animals.

examples.english: We're going on a hunt in Africa next month.
examples.traditional: 我哋下個月去非洲打獵。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 haa6 go3 jyut6 heoi3 fei1 zau1 daa2 lip6

examples.english: The villagers used to go hunting in the mountains all the time.
examples.traditional: 以前啲村民成日入山打獵。
examples.jyutping: ji5 cin4 di1 cyun1 man4 seng4 jat6 jap6 saan1 daa2 lip6
